info.title: SMC scanner
info.description: Screens a watchlist for price touching or near fresh order blocks and fair value gaps. Read-only; it never places trades.

get.description: Choices, defaults and limits for the scan form, plus the watchlist per source.

Scan the given symbols (or the watchlist) on one timeframe.

503 when no symbol could be loaded at all (terminal down, bad login); otherwise the
per-symbol failures are listed next to the rows.

429.description: Too many scans; see the Retry-After header

post.description:
Scan, then ask the AI about the best hits; every row comes back with its AI result.

The scan runs under the scan lock, which is released before any provider call. The
analysis phase is serialised by its own lock, so concurrent identical runs queue and the
second one finds the first one's verdicts instead of calling the provider again.

429 when the daily AI budget is used up (``AI_MAX_CALLS_PER_DAY`` / ``AI_MAX_COST_PER_DAY``)
or the endpoint is rate limited; ``Retry-After`` says when to try again. Hits already
analysed are served from the database even then, since they need no call. A budget refusal
comes when a call is needed: rows analysed before it stay in the database (read them from
``GET /analyses``) but are not in the 429 body.

503.description: Nothing loaded, AI disabled, no database or invalid budget settings

429.description: Rate limited, or the daily AI budget is used up; see Retry-After

502.description: The AI provider failed for the whole run

get.description: Stored analyses, newest first. Pass ``next_cursor`` back to get the following page.

patch.description: Change some fields. Changing the frequency or the enabled flag picks a fresh next slot.

delete.description: Delete a schedule, its sent-alert marks and its job log.

post.description:
Run the schedule once now, waiting for the result.

Takes the same scan lock as ``/scan`` and never queues behind it: 409 when this schedule is
already running or a scan holds the lock. A schedule can be run again only after a cooldown
(429 with ``Retry-After``).

A run that fails (scan or AI error) still answers 200 with ``status`` "failed": the client
must check ``status``, not just the HTTP code. The error text is in the job log only.

503.description: Schedule database or run setup unavailable

409.description: This schedule or a scan is already running

429.description: This schedule was run a moment ago; see the Retry-After header

Retry-After.description: Seconds until this schedule may be run again

get.description: Job-log rows of one schedule, newest first. Pass ``next_cursor`` back for the next page.

post.description:
Send a fixed test message to ``chat_id`` (default ``TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID``). The token is read
from the environment only and never appears in a response or a log.

422.description: Invalid chat id, or none to send to

502.description: Telegram did not accept the message

429.description: Another test message was sent just now

AiResultOut.title: AiResultOut
AiResultOut.description: What the analyst did with one row: its status, the verdict if there is one, a short note.

AiVerdict.title: AiVerdict
AiVerdict.description: Validated verdict. `risk_reward` is computed locally, never taken from the model.

AnalyseRequest.title: AnalyseRequest
AnalyseRequest.description: The ``/scan`` parameters as a JSON body, plus the analyst's knobs.

AnalysedRowOut.title: AnalysedRowOut
AnalysedRowOut.description:
A scan row plus its AI result. A subclass rather than a nullable field on ``ScanRowOut``,
which ``/scan`` also returns and where it would always be null.

AnalysisOut.title: AnalysisOut
AnalysisOut.description: One stored analysis. The context, token counts and error text stay in the database.

ConfigResponse.title: ConfigResponse
ConfigResponse.description: What the scan form needs: choices, defaults, limits and the watchlist per source.

JobLogOut.title: JobLogOut
JobLogOut.description:
One job-log row. ``error`` is raw text (already redacted and bounded): render it as
text, never as markup.

RunOut.title: RunOut
RunOut.description: What a run-now did. Error text is never returned here; see the job log.

ScheduleCreate.title: ScheduleCreate
ScheduleCreate.description: A new schedule. Every field but the first five has a default.

ScheduleUpdate.title: ScheduleUpdate
ScheduleUpdate.description: Any subset of the editable fields. Only ``telegram_chat_id`` may be null (it clears it).
